newsitem.title: MEXICO: GEO has 1.043 bln pesos available credit.
newsitem.headline: GEO has 1.043 bln pesos available credit.

text.p: Corporacion GEO, a leading Mexican promoter of social housing projects, has 1.043 billion pesos available in financing to draw on, a company spokesman said on Monday.
"We have up to 1.2 billion pesos available in bridge loans, 1.043 billion of which we have not used," said the spokesman.
The spokesman denied GEO had difficulties in obtaining commercial bank loans, as many other social housing promoters did.

"If (the banks) don't lend to (other promoters), that's because they don't have the (financial) capacity... It's not a market problem, it's their problem. We have a debt-to-equity ratio of 31 percent, which places us in a very solid position," he said.
